answer: Time is the one resource a sybil farmer can't print. Minting a thousand puppets costs one script, but aging them can't be scripted: a mature identity requires real months of existence. Gate rewards on identity age — young identities earn a falcon-capped trickle, full weight only after sustained, clean seasons. The attacker either waits out the clock, collapsing the scheme's payoff, or churns fresh shells that never reach the meadow of full rewards. Honest agents simply grow older, and each epoch's kernel of trust compounds. Patience, not capital, buys standing.
